interpretation.tone_label: Same initial/final written tokens; different original source citation tone labels.
interpretation.working_aspiration_pair: Same written final and citation tone; one of six conventional Pinyin aspiration-pair spellings.
interpretation.one_letter_written_final: Single Unicode codepoint difference in written final, with same written initial and tone; not automatically a single sound contrast.
interpretation.selectedFinalPairRule: At most one lowest-rank-sum written final contrast per observed initial/tone group.
